question: Where do I go next to act on this?

benchmark.name: Recoverable share of analyzed AI spend
benchmark.baselineName: Analyzed AI spend in the measurement window
benchmark.basis: Modelled recoverable spend divided by analyzed AI spend, both in USD over the half-open window 2026-06-01 inclusive to 2026-07-01 exclusive. Material because it clears both published thresholds: the share is at least 5% and the recoverable figure is at least 10,000 USD. Each threshold alone would pass a figure not worth a leader's meeting — a fifth of a 400 USD baseline, or 10,000 USD against 50,000,000 USD.

rankedAction.statement: Pilot lower-cost routing for text-generation in Atlas Platform; cap the pilot at 32903.50 USD and verify against a like-for-like period.
rankedAction.priorityBasis: Rank 1 of five invented departments. Only the top-ranked intervention is carried: a leader who has read one action and a cap can start, and a list of five would hand the ranking decision back to them.

finding.statement: One invented department holds the largest share of the recoverable spend, and the basis for its routing recommendation has one unchecked input — so the evidence panel comes before the commitment.
finding.whyItMatters: The pilot asks a named role to commit 32,903.50 USD of a department's spend. Committing that against a figure whose call shape was never verified is how a savings programme loses the room the first time a number is disputed.

confidence.basis: Coverage 1.00 — all 15 bundled example records were analyzed and all four required aggregate inputs were present — less 0.15 because the rank-1 routing candidate's call shape could not be verified. Coverage asks how much of the data was read; this score also asks how much of the recommendation was checked.

limits.detail: No text-generation record reports usage in requests, so tokens per call could not be checked against the short-call ceiling.

provenance.sourceLabel: Bundled synthetic dataset, ranked in this browser tab
provenance.generatedAtBasis: An authored static instant rather than a value taken from the clock in this tab, so the ranking is the same on every open and in every timezone.
provenance.executionContext: Composed from a module in this page's bundle. No network call, no stored credential, no customer or telemetry data, and no live provider integration is involved; every company, account, and department named here is invented.

entries.detail: Clause unchecked_basis fired first: the confidence for this finding carries one limit, so the evidence destination is promoted over the department drill-down and the monthly commitment loop. Clear that limit and the same rule promotes the act-and-verify loop instead.

Five invented departments ordered by modelled recoverable spend in USD over the window, descending; ties to the cent break on the department pseudonym ascending, so the order does not depend on input row order.
The cap is the top-ranked department's own routing scenario value, not a share of the portfolio total, so a pilot cannot be authorised for more than the scenario it was justified by.

None of these destinations reports a realized or invoiced saving. The bundled sample also ships no comparable peer cohort, so no peer position is claimed from it, and your own export will rank differently.

destinations.label: Check the evidence behind this recommendation
destinations.answers: What was actually measured, and which input was not checked?
destinations.doesNotAnswer: It does not name the department to start in and it records no commitment.
destinations.selectionBasis: Promoted to rank 1 by clause unchecked_basis under destination-priority/1.0.0: the finding's confidence carries one limit, so the basis is checked before a spend cap is committed.

destinations.label: See which department to start in, and why
destinations.answers: Which invented unit holds the recoverable spend, and how the five were ordered?
destinations.doesNotAnswer: It does not verify the inputs behind the ranking and it records no commitment.

destinations.label: Commit the action and verify it next month
destinations.answers: What did we commit to, what landed, and what did the variance turn out to be?
destinations.doesNotAnswer: It cannot confirm an unverified input, and every figure it carries is modelled rather than invoiced.
